title: A Turnstile save asks the gateway's job to apply
subtitle: Turnstile can start one job. It cannot rewrite gateway policy. The customer-owned job reads desired state, checks it, writes only named values and reads every change back.

groups.title: Customer-owned Container Apps job · user-assigned identity

nodes.title: 1 · Save desired governance
lines: Save catalog, tiers or budgets.
The response does not wait for Azure.
Apply now retries without an edit.

nodes.title: 2 · Start the manual job
lines: [[apply-job-id]]
Turnstile's identity holds [[operator]] on that one job.
A failed start is shown as status.

nodes.title: 3 · Run the pinned scripts
lines: [[runner]] -SkipExport
Pinned commit; job MI sign-in.
[[sync]] -> [[apply]]

nodes.title: Job's gateway role
lines: [[writer-role]]
Read service and operation results; read / write named values.
No policy or network writes.

nodes.title: 4 · Read catalog, current-month budgets and tiers
lines: POST [[prepare]] first rolls the month forward.
GET [[catalog]], [[budgets]] and [[tiers]]
Read the gateway's existing named values in one list call.
The month boundary must not look like every budget was removed.

nodes.title: Refuse unsafe inputs
lines: Demo catalog: refuse.
Invalid ids, tiers or groups: report and omit.
No unit: keep the current registry.
Graph unreadable: no new groups.

nodes.title: 5 · Compute only real changes
lines: Always retain standard and premium tier limits.
Teams need an applied parent.
Compare entries by name, not order.
Without -Apply: preview only.

nodes.title: 6 · Apply and verify
lines: [[set]] writes a changed value.
[[get]] must read back exactly what was written.
Mismatch or write failure stops the run.
Report changes and problems.

nodes.title: Gateway policy consumes the configuration
lines: [[registry]] and [[parents]] carry units, teams and monthly budgets.
The two tiers' TPM, daily quotas and model allowlists are named values.
The next request uses applied configuration; a console save alone is not proof of enforcement.

nodes.title: Membership has its own safety condition
lines: Named-value path: [[membership]] only after Graph is readable and every tier group is confirmed.
Graph application reads need [[graph]] from a tenant administrator.
When [[ent-source]] is projection, leave membership to [[projection]]; never write a large member list here.

notice: The hourly job runs the same governance pass and catches up a failed start. Writes are individually verified, not an atomic multi-value transaction. At this base revision, overlapping jobs can finish out of order; do not describe this as a serialized apply queue.
